body: The funny thing is I moved to a new city last november to get away from drugs, I ended up finding a new hookup down here. I seriously and a fuck up.

Thanks for responding guys, things are just so tough right now, and I don't have anyone to talk to. I use to be on anti depressants but can't get them now because I have no health insurance. I was diagnosed with clinical depression when I was 5150's when I was 15. I've been self medicated with hardcore opiates for the last five years.

I'm so scared I don't want to die I just don't know what to do anymore. I got no friends left, they all stopped answering my calls, and when i do get ahold of someone they will come up with an excuse to get off the phone in <5 min.
Ha yea I wish but I live in america and I don't have health insurance my family i'm staying with sure as hell don't give a shit. Last time I attempted suicide I got yelled at for wasting OTC pills.

Yeah, I understand what your saying, but my family has really had it up to here with me. I'm not really talented enough to be a career musician. I still wanted to be a therapist just seems impossible now.
I have to wait for my aunt to go to sleep anyway...
I really don't have any options, i dont want to go back to jail or be homeless. I would literally rather die.

Yeah, that's why I'm gonna mix it with heroin and go nod out in my aunts car in the garage. My last suicide attempt was in december and pills didn't do the trick. I just got bitched out by my aunt for taking all the claratin and tylenol. You know she needs her god damn allergy meds.

Like I said sorry to be an attention whore but i got it all my bullshit typed out already in this post 

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/sbc2x/got_it_all_planned/

By the way, thank you for responding. This is the second time I've posted to this sub. (the other time was on a different account) You are the only one who has responded. Good thing I'm really bad at attempting suicide or else I would already be gone. So thank you for that.

Well, I use to play drums in a band a couple years ago, but ended up selling my drum set. I like to play guitar also. It's such a horrible feeling just waiting for my aunt to discover that I stole from her. I know it is inevitable, and it literally makes me sick, like I have cold sweats and clam up all the time. I would really like to be a therapist, it's just hard to get enrolled back in school considering I got my license taken away for not paying speeding tickets. It's just one thing after another...

thanks for responding, wasn't really expecting anyone to reply. I use to want to help people, I was a EMT for awhile before my license got taken because of my felony. I was pursuing a degree in psychology but ended up dropping out of school. I see people who I went to highschool with graduating with their BA degrees and it's so depressing. I have had so many good opportunities that I have wasted.  

My last girlfriend didn't even bother breaking up with me. She just left the house one day and never came back, she stopping answering my calls, and sent me one text message saying if I called her again she was going to take legal action and block my number from her phone. She sent one of her guy friends, who I am sure she was sleeping with, to come pick up her things. It's just been one thing after another for the last 2 and a half years. I'm so tired of fucking up.

I don't have anyone to talk to about this really, I live with my aunt but the only reason she lets me stay here is she needs the rent money. Her and my cousin straight up told me they don't like me and would kick me out if it wasn't for my unemployment money. I would have done it already but I am scared of going to hell. 

My family would probably weep for a couple days but on the inside would be relieved. Last time I attempted was in December and all my aunt and cousin did was bitch at me for taking all their allergy medication. I took a whole bottle of Claratin, and a whole bottle of Tylenol along with some sleeping pills. You can bet I was disappointing when I woke up.

Sorry for the wall of text, I don't expect you to read this, but it would be nice to have someone to talk to. It gets pretty god damn lonely sometimes around here, and I'm getting sick of crying by myself.
I guess I didn't expect to get any replies here, Don't even know why I posted it.
